name: Md. Mahim Khan
title: Naval Architect & Offshore Engineering Specialist
headline: Designing the vessels of tomorrow.
subheadline: SHIP DESIGN · ENGINEERING ANALYSIS · MARITIME INNOVATION
bio: I'm Md. Mahim Khan, a dedicated 4th-year student pursuing a B.Sc. in Naval Architecture & Offshore Engineering at Bangladesh Maritime University. With 3+ years of academic experience, I've developed a strong foundation in ship design and engineering analysis. I specialize in creating detailed ship designs, performing complex structural and hydrodynamic analyses, and utilizing programming for engineering automation.
quote: Becoming a skilled naval architect contributing to cutting-edge ship design and offshore engineering worldwide.

projects.title: 2000 DWT Inland Oil Tanker
projects.description: Complete vessel design for inland oil transportation with RINA classification. Engineered as a low-draft classed inland oil tanker optimized for shallow-water navigation and cargo safety.
highlights: Low-draft classed inland oil tanker compliant with RINA rules
Full General Arrangement (GA), Lines Plan, and Midship Section development
Intact & damage stability verification across ballast and full-load conditions
3D NURBS hull surface modeling and hydrostatic table generation

projects.title: Hull Structural Analysis
projects.description: Performing finite element analysis (FEA) on ship hull structures to validate design integrity under various hydrostatic, wave bending, and cargo loading conditions.
highlights: Finite element modeling of hull structure including longitudinal stiffeners and web frames
Validation of structural integrity under extreme wave bending moments
Stress and strain analysis under multiple load cases
Safety factor optimization and proper material selection for different depths

projects.title: Hull Form Optimization
projects.description: Used MAXSURF for hull form development and optimization, achieving significant reduction in wave-making and frictional resistance and improved hydrodynamic performance.
highlights: Hull form generation and parametric modification in MAXSURF
Parametric design optimization for LCB and prismatic coefficient (Cp)
Resistance and propulsion analysis across operational Froude numbers
Performance prediction and CFD streamline validation
